paragraphs.heading: Specified complexity
paragraphs.edited: So why do we recognize design in the city of Petra but not in a typical canyon? Petra has a feature that we call specified complexity. It might sound daunting, but it's actually common sense and intuitive. If something is specified, it has a particular pattern. For example, crystals are specified according to a certain pattern. Shells are specified according to a pattern. Even pulsars emit light at regular intervals. But nobody looks at these and assumes design, because they lack complexity. They can easily be explained by the regular workings of the laws of nature.
